title: Glowing cup of hot cocoa
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffdd66" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="70%" stop-color="#ffdd66" stop-opacity="0.1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffdd66" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cocoa" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8B5A2B"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#6B3A1B"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4A2510"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cup" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D0D8E8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="saucer" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#E8EEF8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B8C4D8"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42" fill="url(#glow)"/>

  <!-- Saucer -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="30" ry="7" fill="url(#saucer)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="30" ry="6" fill="#F0F4FF"/>

  <!-- Cup body -->
  <path d="M26 40 L28 78 Q29 82 34 82 L66 82 Q71 82 72 78 L74 40 Z" fill="url(#cup)"/>

  <!-- Cup highlight -->
  <path d="M30 44 L31.5 74 Q32 77 35 77 L38 77 L36 44 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d="M73 48 Q90 48 88 62 Q86 74 73 72" fill="none" stroke="#E0E8F4" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M73 48 Q88 48 86 62 Q84 72 73 71" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Cocoa surface -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="41" rx="23" ry="7" fill="url(#cocoa)"/>

  <!-- Cocoa inner rim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="41" rx="21" ry="5.5" fill="#7B4A2B"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="41" rx="18" ry="4.5" fill="#5D3018"/>

  <!-- Glow from cocoa -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="41" rx="16" ry="4" fill="#FFB844" opacity="0.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="41" rx="10" ry="2.5" fill="#FFDD88" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Steam -->
  <path d="M40 32 Q36 24 40 16 Q44 8 40 2" fill="none" stroke="#FFDD88" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M50 30 Q47 22 51 14 Q55 6 51 0" fill="none" stroke="#FFEEAA" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.9"/>
  <path d="M60 32 Q56 24 60 16 Q64 8 60 2" fill="none" stroke="#FFDD88" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- Small marshmallows -->
  <rect x="42" y="38" width="6" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
  <rect x="53" y="39" width="5" height="3.5" rx="1.5" fill="#FFF8F0" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- Cocoa sparkle -->
  <circle cx="48" cy="39" r="1" fill="#FFE880" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="40" r="0.8" fill="#FFE880" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
